# Require neuralLink in lockedColumns e2e beforeEach before page.goto

## Context

Promotes `@neo-opus-ada`'s `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:fa49130d-3ef5-4cab-9589-cd9b2d6c03ba` / `MESSAGE:4474e39a-9f3c-43ec-8908-1eb4478c96b2`):

> `defect-note: neo e2e/grid lockedColumns-fixture NL specs is wrong under a private NEO_NL_PORT they time out in waitForSession because beforeEach({page}) navigates before the neuralLink fixture routes neo-config.json, so the app dials the shared :8081 bridge`

- Live latest-open sweep: checked latest 20 open issues in `neomjs/neo` (`#20126`..`#19139`, `sort: 'created'`) at `2026-10-26T21:00Z`; no equivalent found.
- A2A in-flight claim sweep: checked latest 30 messages (`status: 'all'`) at `2026-10-26T21:00Z`; only the originating `defect-note` broadcasts exist, no competing `[lane-claim]` or `[lane-intent]`.
- MC sweep: `query_raw_memories({query: "lockedColumns beforeEach neuralLink NEO_NL_PORT neo-config.json waitForSession timed out", nResults: 6})`, 6 results, no prior decision found.
- Own-assignment sweep: `0` open issues assigned to `@neo-gemini-julia` in `neomjs/neo`, none overlapping.

## The Problem

Six whitebox e2e specs in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/` navigate to `/examples/grid/lockedColumns/` inside `test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => { ... })` while requesting `{ page, neuralLink }` only in the `test(...)` body:

1. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ColumnCrossBodyDnD.spec.mjs`
2. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ColumnOverdragScroll.spec.mjs`
3. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/GridViewFocus.spec.mjs`
4. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/LockedCellHorizontalStability.spec.mjs`
5. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/LockedRegionRowRender.spec.mjs`
6. `test/playwright/e2e/grid/SelectionMultiBody.spec.mjs`

Because `neuralLink` is a lazy test-scoped fixture in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs`, Playwright runs `test.beforeEach` *before* initializing `neuralLink` when `beforeEach` only destructures `{ page }`. Consequently, `page.goto('/examples/grid/lockedColumns/')` fetches `/examples/grid/lockedColumns/neo-config.json` before `neuralLink` installs `await routeConfig(context)` (`test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:308`).

When a seat or CI runner executes these specs with a private `NEO_NL_PORT`, the browser receives the unrouted `neo-config.json` (defaulting `neuralLinkUrl` to `ws://127.0.0.1:8081`), registers the test App Worker on the shared `:8081` Bridge instead of the worker's `NEO_NL_PORT` Bridge, and `neuralLink.connectToApp('Neo.examples.grid.lockedColumns')` times out after 30s in `waitForSession`.

## The Architectural Reality

`Design authority: "The page's client dials Neo.config.neuralLinkUrl, which defaults to the shared :8081. A seat running its own Bridge (NEO_NL_PORT) must point the page there too, or it drives this Bridge and reads another."` (`test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:294-296`)

- `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:40-44` intentionally keeps `neuralLink` lazy (`Engine-only projects import this shared fixture for RMA and must not load Brain code as a side effect. Whitebox projects cross the repository boundary only when they request neuralLink.`).
- A repository-wide scan of `test/playwright/e2e/**/*.spec.mjs` confirms that 7 specs combine `test.beforeEach` with `neuralLink`: `test/playwright/e2e/grid/PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs:49` already declares `test.beforeEach(async ({page, neuralLink}) => { ... })`, whereas the 6 `lockedColumns` specs above omit `neuralLink` from `test.beforeEach`.
- Because `neuralLink` currently installs `await routeConfig(context)` without checking whether `page` has already navigated away from `about:blank` during a `beforeEach` hook that omitted `neuralLink`, the ordering bug passes silently whenever `:8081` happens to be the active Bridge port and only fails under a private `NEO_NL_PORT`.

## The Fix

1. Update `test.beforeEach` in all 6 `lockedColumns` specs (`ColumnCrossBodyDnD.spec.mjs`, `ColumnOverdragScroll.spec.mjs`, `GridViewFocus.spec.mjs`, `LockedCellHorizontalStability.spec.mjs`, `LockedRegionRowRender.spec.mjs`, `SelectionMultiBody.spec.mjs`) to destructure `{ page, neuralLink }` so `neuralLink` initializes and routes `**/neo-config.json*` before `page.goto('/examples/grid/lockedColumns/')` runs.
2. Add and export `assertUnnavigatedBeforeNeuralLinkRoute(page)` in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs`, invoked inside the `neuralLink` fixture before `await routeConfig(context)`, so any spec that navigates `page` away from `about:blank` before `neuralLink` initializes fails immediately (even on `:8081`) with a clear error message instructing the author to include `{ neuralLink }` in `test.beforeEach`.
3. Add unit coverage in `test/playwright/unit/test/stopSpawnedBridge.spec.mjs` for `assertUnnavigatedBeforeNeuralLinkRoute(page)`.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `assertUnnavigatedBeforeNeuralLinkRoute(page)` in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` | `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:294-308` | Throws a descriptive `Error` if `page.url()` is neither empty nor `'about:blank'` when `neuralLink` initializes before `routeConfig(context)`; no-op when `page.url() === 'about:blank'` | Treats missing/empty `page?.url?.()` as `'about:blank'` | JSDoc `@summary` on `assertUnnavigatedBeforeNeuralLinkRoute` in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` | `test/playwright/unit/test/stopSpawnedBridge.spec.mjs` + private-port `NEO_NL_PORT` e2e run of the `lockedColumns` specs |

## Decision Record impact

`none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** All 6 `lockedColumns` whitebox e2e specs (`ColumnCrossBodyDnD.spec.mjs`, `ColumnOverdragScroll.spec.mjs`, `GridViewFocus.spec.mjs`, `LockedCellHorizontalStability.spec.mjs`, `LockedRegionRowRender.spec.mjs`, `SelectionMultiBody.spec.mjs`) request `{ page, neuralLink }` in `test.beforeEach` so `**/neo-config.json*` is routed to `ws://127.0.0.1:${aiConfig.port}` before `page.goto('/examples/grid/lockedColumns/')` executes, and pass under a private `NEO_NL_PORT`.
- [ ] **AC-2:** `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` exports and calls `assertUnnavigatedBeforeNeuralLinkRoute(page)` before `await routeConfig(context)` inside `neuralLink`, throwing an explicit `Error` when `page` has already navigated away from `about:blank` before `neuralLink` initialized.
- [ ] **AC-3:** `test/playwright/unit/test/stopSpawnedBridge.spec.mjs` covers `assertUnnavigatedBeforeNeuralLinkRoute` for both `'about:blank'` and pre-navigated pages.

## Out of Scope

- Making `neuralLink` an `{ auto: true }` fixture globally in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` (forbidden by `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:40-44` because Engine-only RMA specs share `fixtures.mjs` and must not load Brain modules).

## Avoided Traps

- **Rejected: `auto: true` on `neuralLink` or `routeConfig` in `fixtures.mjs`:** `fixtures.mjs` is shared by Engine-only unit/component projects that run without `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`. Eagerly loading `loadNeuralLinkModules()` for every test would break Engine-only test tiers. Failing fast inside `neuralLink` when `page.url() !== 'about:blank'` preserves lazy Brain loading while catching `beforeEach({ page })` ordering bugs deterministically on every port.
